subject: Original bootstrap reply-source adapter, fixed publication packet

analytical_conclusions.reason: Adjacent ACK hybrids are identical before the r-th registration; absent-registration terms therefore cancel. The remaining event is partitioned by fixed original pairs within each actual endpoint. A parent-source opening before registration permanently excludes that pair because S0 and all traditional scalars are actually disclosed in this profile. An opening after registration uses the original U1 pre-return stop and retains the stopped prefix and latched event. Candidate-local zero assignments are not promoted to a whole-view identity.

Durable first retention precedes selected generation/encapsulation. Retried or restored operations preserve the original token and saved body. Challenge origins are fixed at the original generation/first encapsulation, and the immutable complete source tuple is fixed before its first CB use. Registration follows Reply verification/signing and precedes ACK use. The early fresh-body signature monitor and explicit initial/reply correctness costs support the same-family endpoint invariant. Same-body outer-signature aliases preserve the upstream tuple and PRK while retaining separate full-wire root descriptors.

analytical_conclusions.topic: Component routing, fresh ciphertext collisions and import validation
analytical_conclusions.reason: The postchallenge selected-owner c* route uses the cached challenge key and never sends c* to the postchallenge CCA oracle. All other honest same-PQ-key encapsulations and expanded-owner validations are cached and monitored, including those before challenge creation. Equality with c* on the K-PKE-correctness good event implies equality of the original 32-byte inputs. Counting fixed original fresh-input slots, including discarded and selectively executed reservations, gives v/2^256 plus the explicit joint correctness event. The selected original retry is not a new slot. These stops supply the claimed single selected CB-tuple interface.

analytical_conclusions.topic: Opaque record closure and hybrid order
analytical_conclusions.reason: The raw acquisition monitor covers the union of unknown-value dependencies through generation/encapsulation tapes, expanded owner, CB/PRK/seed, retained roots and activation records. Raw ciphertext acquisition is counted even without a matching decryption key. The proof first compares constructible real records with commitment/structural tables and only then installs unknown component tapes. The one record cost per local endpoint is sufficient because both final endpoint experiments retain the same table renderer.

analytical_conclusions.topic: Two-endpoint acquisition residual and complete budget
analytical_conclusions.reason: eta_cap,r sums the selected-pair capture event in both adjacent endpoint distributions; it is not silently evaluated only in H_0. Pair-event disjointness is used only inside each endpoint. The R telescoping ranks, G times A ex ante original pairs, and two real-to-common-table endpoints yield the explicit 2 R G A coefficient. All primitive and monitor budgets cover the complete derived execution and final candidate bit. The final full-table coupling preserves candidate attribution, registration flags, all allowed outputs and the same latched test.

identified_issues_resolved_in_this_packe.resolution: The monitor covers previous cached and later fresh same-PQ-key ciphertexts, stopping before an excluded oracle query or inconsistent known-key comparison.

identified_issues_resolved_in_this_packe.resolution: v_j counts original fresh-m sampling slots, including unused and failed-retention reservations; the finite 7/16 countermodel rejects the incorrect 1/4 bound.
